lines.t: Met her by the mangoes, basket full of grace,
Talkin’ ‘bout the ripened hearts we’re called to cultivate.
She said, “The harvest’s comin’ — better check your vine!”
I said, “Girl, I’m pruning patience right here in line!”
We’re bearin’ much fruit, in the produce light,
Grapes of joy and love so bright.
The harvest is near, can you feel that sound?
He’s gatherin’ souls where the melons are found!
She pointed at tomatoes, said, “Don’t be green too long,
He’s ripening His people to sing that perfect song.”
I laughed near the lemons, said, “I once was sour too,
Till mercy juiced my spirit — now I’m fresh and new!”
We’re bearin’ much fruit, in the produce light,
Grapes of joy and love so bright.
The harvest is near, can you feel that sound?
He’s gatherin’ souls where the melons are found!
From the aisles of time to eternity’s door,
He’s callin’ the willing to bear even more.
So grab your cart and your heart, let His goodness grow,
Every little seed of faith will overflow!
We’re bearin’ much fruit, in the produce light,
Harvest hands lifted high all night.
Singin’ hallelujah by the avocado stand,
Two shoppers preachin’ love — that was God’s plan!
